zoom__load_failed: Could not load this appointment. Please try again.
zoom__sign_in_help: Sign in as the patient using the phone number on the appointment, or sign in as the assigned practitioner.
zoom__otp_failed: Unable to verify. Check your phone number or code and try again.
zoom__session_expired: Your CARE session has expired. Please sign in again.
zoom__unavailable: This appointment is unavailable or you do not have access.
zoom__sdk_failed: Video could not be prepared. Use a current browser over HTTPS (or localhost), check your connection, and try again.
zoom__prejoin_help: These checks stay on this device. Join when you are ready, then enable your audio.
zoom__system_speaker: This browser uses your system speaker. Change it in your device settings.
zoom__enable_audio_hint: Select Enable audio to hear and speak in the call.
zoom__disconnected: The call disconnected. You can return to the device check and try joining again.
zoom__call_ended: The call has ended for everyone.
zoom__media_denied: Camera or microphone access is blocked. Allow access in your browser settings, then try again. You can still join with your camera off.
zoom__device_missing: The selected camera or microphone is unavailable. Connect a device or choose another one.
zoom__media_failed: The media operation failed. Check your device and connection, then try again.
zoom__join_failed: Could not join the call. Check your connection and appointment access, then try again.
zoom__leave_failed: Could not end the call for everyone. Try again, or leave this call.
